summary.text: Jimmy Higdon is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 14, with House service from 2003 to 2009 and Senate service since 2009. The legislature's profile lists Higdon as chair of the Senate Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Jimmy Higdon was born in 1953, is a small business owner, and holds a B.S. from MoSU.
The profile also lists U.S. Army Reserve service.

It lists board or committee roles with the Lebanon-Marion County Industrial Foundation, the Nelson County Economic Development Agency, the Kentucky Workforce Innovation Board, and an affordable housing trust.
